headline: An attacker exploited Optimizely's web experimentation platform to plant malicious JavaScript on at least 178 customers' websites, among them CNN, the BBC, Fox News, Zoom, GitLab, Salesforce, Equifax, HSBC, and IKEA, serving visitors a payment card skimmer, cryptocurrency theft code, and iOS exploit kits.

emerging_trends.text: Attackers keep entering through the vendors everyone else loads, with one Optimizely script reaching 178 customer sites and a single stolen Fireworks AI key reaching Uber's drivers and Cursor's extension marketplace.

topics.title: Optimizely Scripts Serve Malware to 178 Sites
topics.latest_developments: Optimizely confirmed early Tuesday, November 17, 2026 that an unauthorized party exploited a vulnerability in its Experimentation product and added malicious JavaScript to some customer projects, and Report URI, which monitors the scripts websites run, counted at least 178 organizations serving that code to visitors on Monday, among them CNN, the BBC, Fox News, Zoom, GitLab, Salesforce, Equifax, HSBC, and IKEA.
topics.summary: Customers embed Optimizely Web through a JavaScript snippet their pages fetch from Optimizely's own servers, so tampering at Optimizely reaches every visitor. The injected code stole cryptocurrency and payment card details typed on checkout pages and fired exploit kits at iOS devices; site owners should audit Monday's sessions and card transactions and force users to rotate exposed wallet credentials.

topics.title: AI Agents Run Intrusions With No Human
topics.latest_developments: Google Threat Intelligence Group and Mandiant found threat actors handing whole stages of live intrusions to AI agents, with at least one operation that needs no human to turn a newly released patch into a working attack; Dark Reading reported ransomware attack volume climbing on the back of large language models that write convincing phishing and locate sensitive data fast while victim payments decline, and separately detailed a sleeper agent technique that hides a payload inside 0.00001 percent of an open-weight model's neurons.
topics.summary: The mechanics of these break-ins stay familiar—stolen credentials and unpatched systems—and the speed changes. Palo Alto Networks' State of Cloud Security Report 2026 found 99 percent of organizations already let AI agents act autonomously or semiautonomously in development pipelines, with 40 percent unable to retrace what those agents did, so defenders need agent-level logging and shorter patch windows.

sources.title: Google finds AI agent writing and launching exploits with no human in the loop

topics.title: ShadowCloud Hides C2 in GitHub and SharePoint
topics.latest_developments: Kaspersky published both halves of its analysis of Operation ShadowCloud, a campaign it first identified in early 2026 against government networks in Asia and Africa, naming two previously undocumented backdoors—GitDoor, which takes orders through GitHub, and GraphDoor, which runs its command and control through Microsoft SharePoint—plus the shellcode families and plug-ins they load; Unit 42 disclosed a separate Southeast Asian espionage campaign built on the PerfectPioneer remote access trojan and the modular KUKURAT, which hide their traffic in HTTP/3 over QUIC.
topics.summary: Both sets of operators route stolen data and commands through services a government network already trusts, which blunts domain blocking and reputation filtering. Defenders in government environments should inspect outbound HTTP/3 and QUIC traffic and treat machine-to-machine calls to GitHub and SharePoint as worth logging.

topics.title: Anthropic Cuts Disclosure to 30 Days
topics.latest_developments: Anthropic will publish high- and critical-severity vulnerabilities 30 days after it reports them to a vendor or an open-source maintainer, down from 90, and give every other bug 45 days, with the new deadlines covering reports it sends on or after January 1, 2027 and already-open reports keeping their original clocks; Dark Reading found practitioners split over Google Project Zero's parallel move from 120 days to 30 over the next 14 months.
topics.summary: Anthropic argues a reported bug can no longer stay private for months, because one model finding a flaw implies others will find it too. Vendors and maintainers who depend on long remediation windows have six weeks to rebuild their patch pipelines before the shorter deadlines take effect.

sources.title: Anthropic vulnerability disclosure deadline drops to 30 days for serious bugs

topics.title: Fireworks AI Breach Reaches Uber Drivers
topics.latest_developments: Uber named the third party behind its breach: attackers who compromised Fireworks AI, the AI infrastructure provider, in early October 2026 took the data of nearly 150,000 Uber drivers, and the company began notifying them; SecurityWeek confirmed the same Fireworks intrusion seeded the Cursor attack, where the thief stole an access key, used it to pull further credentials, and pushed malicious copies of a Claude Code extension through Cursor's marketplace.
topics.summary: One compromise at an AI infrastructure vendor now accounts for driver license numbers at Uber, chat transcripts at Notion, and a poisoned developer extension at Cursor. Any company that routed data or credentials through Fireworks AI should rotate keys issued to it and review what that vendor could read.

sources.title: Uber notifies drivers of data breach affecting nearly 150,000 people
Cursor Supply Chain Attack Started at Fireworks AI

topics.title: N-able and ConnectWise Patch Again
topics.latest_developments: N-able shipped N-central 2026.4 Hotfix 3, which it calls a critical security update, closing 17 more flaws while attackers keep exploiting the earlier bugs to plant cryptocurrency miners; ConnectWise completed its investigation into the unauthorized access of partner ScreenConnect environments, told customers to run technician client 26.6.5 or later, and said reports of fresh activity continue against on-premises installations that still enable the implicated third-party extensions.
topics.summary: Both products sit at the top of managed service provider estates, so one unpatched server exposes every customer endpoint it manages. Administrators should install N-central Hotfix 3, verify the ScreenConnect technician client version, and disable the third-party extensions ConnectWise flagged.

sources.title: N-able Patches 17 N-central Flaws as Attackers Exploit Earlier Bugs to Deploy Crypto Miners

business_politics.title: A 15-Million-File Leak Hits Deutsche Bank
business_politics.latest_developments: The Financial Times and partner outlets published the first tranche of 15 million leaked internal documents Tuesday, November 17, and Deutsche Bank shares fell.
business_politics.summary: Whistleblower-leaked emails, internal investigation files, and board material from Deutsche Bank, Germany's largest lender, show compliance staff raising alarms while executives pushed for profits and new business with Russian oligarchs shortly before the full-scale invasion of Ukraine, record dealings with Jeffrey Epstein far larger than previously known, and the 2017 data breach that exposed President Trump's tax statements, which Christian Sewing—then head of the private bank and now chief executive—described internally as an "awful mistake." The documents put Sewing's leadership of a globally systemically important bank under direct scrutiny.

business_politics.title: Global Selloff Before Nvidia's First Report Without Huang
business_politics.latest_developments: Asian and European equities fell across every sector Tuesday, November 17, and Nasdaq futures slipped as traders waited for Nvidia's results, the first since Jensen Huang's exit, while Nvidia itself created a board committee to oversee national security and compliance with United States export controls.
business_politics.summary: The Commerce Department's new crackdown on chip shipments to China, published Monday, November 16, deepened doubts about the pace of the artificial-intelligence data center build-out and drove the risk-off move; gold held below $3,900 an ounce on expectations of a Federal Reserve rate increase next month, the DXY dollar index traded flat after touching a 19-month high overnight, and crude kept falling as recovering Middle Eastern exports point to a global supply surplus.

business_politics.title: Ukraine Severs the Crimean Bridge
business_politics.latest_developments: A section of the road crossing collapsed and the parallel rail bridge took damage in the drone and cruise-missile attack, and Russia answered by striking infrastructure in Kyiv.
business_politics.summary: The Crimean Bridge carries Russia's main road and rail link to the occupied peninsula and supplies its southern front, and Ukraine's strike follows weeks of Russian attacks on bridges in the Ukrainian capital. The exchange lands days before President Trump meets Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping in China.

business_politics.title: Trump Lands in Asia for the Shenzhen Trilateral
business_politics.latest_developments: President Trump arrived in the Philippines Tuesday, November 17, to meet regional blocs before the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum in China, and the Wall Street Journal reported that neither he nor Xi Jinping plans to raise Nvidia when they sit down.
business_politics.summary: The forum sets up the first meeting to put the American, Chinese, and Russian heads of state in one room, with Trump's advisers openly split over China policy. Beijing spent the run-up courting middle powers, and Xi and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney agreed to cut tariffs on each other's goods, a hedge against Washington that analysts warn deepens Ottawa's dependence on China.

business.title: Pool City Goes Out of Business
business.latest_developments: KDKA reported Monday night, November 16, that Pool City will close after more than 70 years.
business.summary: Pool City, the Pittsburgh-area swimming pool, spa, and patio furniture chain, is shutting down after seven decades selling to homeowners across Western Pennsylvania. The closing follows Schwebel's equipment auction as another long-running regional retailer winds up.

business.latest_developments: WTAE reported Monday night, November 16, that Ross Park Mall will add eight stores, among them Vuori, Jo Malone London, and Tommy Bahama.
business.summary: The Vuori store becomes the activewear brand's first location in Western Pennsylvania. The leases keep Ross Park Mall in Ross Township filling space while Monroeville Mall heads toward what TribLive called its last holiday season.

business.title: Adelphoi Plans a $12.5 Million Latrobe Build
business.latest_developments: TribLive reported Tuesday, November 17, that Adelphoi Inc. could break ground soon on the project.
business.summary: Adelphoi Inc., the Latrobe-based youth services nonprofit, will spend $12.5 million to build a 15-bed secure treatment facility for troubled youth on its Latrobe campus, adding construction work and beds in Westmoreland County.

around_town.title: Ambulances Still Run Slow on Andover Terrace
around_town.latest_developments: PublicSource reported Tuesday, November 17, that median 911 response times on Andover Terrace have risen more than 25% since the 2022 landslide, and that repairs may not finish until 2028.
around_town.summary: A landslide four years ago cut the Hill District street, forcing emergency crews onto longer routes to reach residents of Andover Terrace. Neighbors told PublicSource they are still waiting on the city, asking whether it will take somebody dying to speed the work.

around_town.title: The Daily Counts Pittsburgh's Schoolchildren
around_town.latest_developments: Pittsburgh City Paper reported Tuesday, November 17, that The Daily, the New York Times podcast, devoted an episode to Pittsburgh Public Schools.
around_town.summary: The episode examines the district's long slide in student population and asks whether enough children remain to keep its school buildings open, putting a national audience on a question Pittsburgh Public Schools has wrestled with through closure debates.

around_town.title: Dense Fog and a Freezing Start
around_town.latest_developments: WTAE and WPXI put dense fog over the Pittsburgh area early Tuesday, November 17, with temperatures near or below freezing creating slick spots on untreated roads, bridges, and elevated surfaces before sunshine returns.
around_town.summary: The cold morning precedes the warm-up forecasters have placed in the second half of the week, with the next rain chance holding off until Sunday, November 22. The Pennsylvania Department of Environmental Protection has a Code Orange air quality alert in effect for Allegheny County today.

team_usa.title: Pochettino Coaches His Last U.S. Match
team_usa.latest_developments: Mauricio Pochettino ends his tenure as United States men's national team head coach with Tuesday's Concacaf Nations League quarterfinal second leg, and ESPN spent the day canvassing successors and arguing the job does not require a coach of Pep Guardiola's stature.
team_usa.summary: Pochettino leaves for Manchester United after U.S. Soccer accepted a $10 million release clause, and Steve Cherundolo runs the December camp on an interim basis with the 2027 cycle ahead. Pochettino said he would urge Guardiola to take the United States post and called it the perfect moment to arrive.
